ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future case, including the conviction of Salim Said and the restitution order. It would also explore the larger implications of the case and potential connections to other similar cases.
questions: What was the extent of the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future case has significant implications for the individuals and organizations affected by the fraud scheme. Further investigation is needed to uncover the full extent of the scheme and identify other potential defendants.

ideas.title: The Nancy Guthrie Case: A Review of the Evidence
ideas.description: This story would review the evidence in the Nancy Guthrie case and examine the controversy surrounding the Pima County sheriff's handling of the case.
questions: What is the current status of the investigation?
ideas.insight: The Nancy Guthrie case raises questions about the handling of the investigation and the potential for misconduct by the Pima County sheriff. Further investigation is needed to determine the facts of the case.
